latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – interact with the Ceaser privacy protocol on Base L2.

- Query denominations, fees, pool stats, Merkle roots, and facilitator status via public API endpoints.
- Shield and unshield ETH using CLI subcommands (`npx ceaser-mcp shield/unshield/notes`).
- Supports gasless settlement for withdrawals through the x402 facilitator.
- Provides CLI tools for managing notes and importing/exporting backups.
- Relies on client-side ZK proof generation (not handled within this skill).
- Includes comprehensive documentation for API usage and command-line workflows.
